A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 21-page versions of the same Laser paper, including Appendices A-J. Full-text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison; pages 5-21 are visually identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results, efficiency measurements, ablations, and appendix experiments, including the RL comparison in Table 4 and human annotation assessment in Appendix I.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, efficiency measurements, ablations, RL experiments, and human annotation results.

M1.justification: DWAL, dynamic semantic windows, Self-Refined Superposition, entropy intervention, and training losses are unchanged. The appendix EPG-GRPO and time-decay variants were already present in v1.

E1.justification: The ScanPath training data, six main evaluation benchmarks, and generalization tasks in Table 3 are unchanged. The new Laser-ScanPath link supplies access information for the existing dataset, not additional experimental coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main benchmark, efficiency, generalization, and task-category comparisons. Monet and LVR remain the latent reasoning baselines in Table 1.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1-4.3 and Appendices A-C retain the same backbone, training settings, resolution constraints, metrics, and sample sizes. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The component ablations, generalization analyses, interpretability examples, RL comparison, parameter sweeps, time-decay analysis, and Appendix J case studies are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the benchmark results. Appendix I retains the same annotation assessment and Fleiss' kappa of 0.677.

E6.justification: Reported scores, token counts, ablation outcomes, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains overall scores of 66.58 for Laser and 61.55 for Monet; Table 4 retains 66.73 for Laser + EPG.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations (1)-(17), including the main DWAL formulation and appendix RL and time-decay objectives, are unchanged. No assumptions, proofs, or mathematical corrections are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about hierarchical latent reasoning, interpretability, performance, efficiency, and generalization.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and applicability qualifications are unchanged, including Section 5's discussion of weaker absolute localization and pixel-level precision. The appendix interpretations introduce no new explanations or limitations.

D1.justification: v2 adds a direct Hugging Face link for Laser-ScanPath above the abstract. The code link is relocated and shortened to the same repository; implementation, hardware, hyperparameter, and data-generation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 46 reference entries are unchanged. The paper retains its positioning relative to autoregressive, explicit, and latent reasoning approaches.

P1.justification: Small front-matter edits add Code and Dataset labels and move the abstract's inline code reference into the resource block. The version/date header changes, while scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: A two-row resource block with icons changes the first-page layout and causes limited reflow on pages 1-4, including shifting Figure 1. Existing figures and tables are preserved; pages 5-21 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds a concrete dataset access pointer absent from v1 and clearly groups the code and dataset links. This modestly improves resource discoverability and reproducibility documentation. The scientific arguments, results, and appendix analyses are unchanged.
